name: remove the most central edge repeatedly
mechanism: compute for every edge how many shortest paths pass through it, remove the edge with the largest count, recompute, and repeat; the components that appear are the communities

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Girvan–Newman algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Network theory: detect communities in complex systems

fails_when: no principled stopping point (modularity is a separate policy)
